context.description: Everything the rest of the round needs from outside the loop, restated. Inside a loop a stage can only reference its siblings, so this is the only channel by which the brief's venue/claim and the reference spec reach paper-figures, paper-write, paper-audit, paper-review and paper-revise. Copy these values verbatim from the injected brief and calibration results; do not paraphrase and do not omit a field because it seems obvious.

evidence.description: The brief's evidence block. paper-audit's whole job is comparing a number in the text to the file that produces it, and inside the loop this is the only place it can learn where those files are.

contributions.description: The brief's contributions, restated so paper-review can check claim-to-evidence reach without the brief.

figure_directives.description: What paper-figures must change this round. The review's figure findings arrive here and only here: paper-figures reads this array, not the review result, so anything you leave out of it is silently dropped. Empty is a legal value and means the figures need no change this round.

figure.description: A figure id from the figure set, a fig. number, or a role from the reference spec's figure_grammar when the figure does not exist yet.

directive.description: The change, as an instruction paper-figures can execute.

from_issue.description: The review or audit issue id this answers.

why_now.description: Why this unit has the largest claim gap this round.

addresses_issues.description: Issue ids from the previous round's review/audit this target responds to.

blocked_units.description: Units with a larger gap that cannot be targeted because their evidence does not exist yet.

reader_knows.description: Only concepts introduced earlier may appear here.

why_here.description: Why the reader is ready now; must reference what came before.

evidence.description: The number/table/figure/citation backing it. 'none' is refused for a claim.

notes.description: The gaps found (with paragraph ids and the concrete repair), plus the ordering decision and the alternatives rejected. Required even when every check passes.

state_path.description: The storyline state file this round updated.

context.core_claim: A single tile-level operator grammar, co-designed with a validation harness, lets an LLM reach hand-tuned kernel performance on dense and sparse GEMM without a per-operator codebase.

contributions.statement: A tile-level operator grammar expressive enough to state dense and sparse GEMM in one language.

figure_directives.directive: Add the shape counts under each bar group and a dashed parity line; the current figure reads as a run chart rather than a speedup comparison.
figure_directives.why: The reference spec's headline-speedup rule requires a parity reference and the sample count, and R4 says the reader cannot tell what the baseline was measured on.

round_target.why_now: The claim that a tiling error costs a message instead of a hang is the paper's second contribution, and §3.2 currently asserts it without the 353-check taxonomy the reference spec shows in the same position.
blocked_units: §5.2 has a larger gap but its sparse-GEMM figure does not exist yet.

layer_status.notes: Claim and C1-C3 copied from brief.json unchanged.
Three subsections: co-design premise, static checks, diagnostics.

paragraphs.topic_sentence: The compiler is co-designed with the harness, so a tile error is reported before the kernel runs.
paragraphs.reader_knows: §3.1 established that the grammar is source-to-source; the reader now expects to learn what the compiler does with it.
paragraphs.why_here: §3.1 closed by saying the grammar's value depends on what consumes it, so the reader is ready for the consumer.
paragraphs.evidence: Contrast with standalone template compilers; the compile-time check count.
paragraphs.leads_to: Two concrete capabilities: static checks, then located diagnostics.

gate.notes: §2.3 closes on the cost of a failed launch, which does not yet set up §3's opener; repair by adding a clause to §2.3's closer mapping that cost to the co-design premise. Ordering chosen: mechanism → evidence → consequence; rejected consequence-first because §3.1 already ended on the consumer question.

orphan_contributions: C3 has no evaluation artifact: §5.4 cites a table that was removed in the last revision.
